svg.title: The Hoffman Agency Design System
svg.desc: Navy banner: the stretched hello in the brand colours, the line "Point an LLM here. Ship things that stay on brand.", the agency positioning, and six tiles previewing the palette, the two typefaces, 75 Fluent emoji, 49 photographs, 36 illustrations and 1595 icons, with the Storyline squiggle edge-locked at the right.
svg.text: DESIGN SYSTEM · 48 SLIDE LAYOUTS · A 23-SCREEN INTERACTIVE TOUR
